the backoff ladder runs 1 min, 10 min, 1 h, 6 h, 24 h — not a 17-minute cap
the untyped markFailed path still honours the attempts cap
an exhausted row counts as failed in BOTH count projections
error_message carries the exception text, not a fixed literal
listFailedJobs reports each row's real terminal state, not a blanket FAILED
a retry reports the state it actually replaced, not a hardcoded FAILED
